Overview of Ulsan Region (Ulsan)

Ulsan Region (Ulsan) is located in the Ulsan region of South Korea, with its prefectural capital at Ulsan. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Historic cultural district, Traditional market (Sijang), Mountain & river parks, Local museum & heritage trail.

RegionUlsan
Capital cityUlsan
Cities & municipalities20
Primary transport hubUlsan Central Station (KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail)

How to get to Ulsan Region

Connected via KORAIL KTX / SRT high-speed rail, Express Bus terminals, and T-money nationwide transit card. Use our KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Ulsan

When visiting cities across Ulsan, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Korean BBQ (Samgyeopsal & Hanwoo)
  • Bibimbap
  • Kimchi jjigae
  • Tteokbokki & street food
  • Local makgeolli

Best time to visit Ulsan

Best time to visit Ulsan: Apr–May, Sep–Nov.
